The WebSurfer had successfully identified the director as Gustaf Molander from the search snippets, but the Planner erroneously concluded that the director was "George Cukor (per Wikipedia/IMDb snippet shown by the WebSurfer)." This error led the Planner to initiate a new search for George Cukor's birthplace, wasting steps and delaying the correct identification of Gustaf Molander's birthplace.
